description: Visual variant of a TmChatBubble. Each member maps to the tm-chat-bubble--{variant} modifier class and to one of the --tm-chat-bubble-* custom property sets: Incoming→in, Outgoing→out, System and Pill→system, Pending, Queued, Discarded and Locked. Discarded renders its body as a semantic <del> element; Locked never renders the body, so locked content cannot leak into the DOM.

values.name: Incoming
values.description: A message received from somebody else.

values.name: Outgoing
values.description: A message sent by the current user.

values.name: System
values.description: A system event row (joins, leaves, status changes).

values.name: Pill
values.description: A compact inline pill (tips, short notices); shares the system colour set.

values.name: Pending
values.description: Content still being processed (an AI draft awaiting review); dashed border.

values.name: Queued
values.description: Content waiting to be delivered (a scheduled message); info tint.

values.name: Discarded
values.description: Withdrawn content struck through with a semantic <del> and a host-provided note.

values.name: Locked
values.description: Locked content — the body is never rendered, only badges/notes/actions (e.g. a PPV price).
